hook.title: Paanch sau patients ke liye ek line
hook.md:
Ek clinical trial mein 500 patients ka dose milligrams mein darj hai, aur report mein grams chahiye. List ke saath aap `for` loop likhkar har ek ko divide karenge. **NumPy** ke saath aap `doses / 1000` likhte hain, aur sabhi 500 ek saath badal jaate hain.

**NumPy** (Numerical Python) woh library hai jo Python ko numbers ke saath tez banaati hai. Unit IV ka Pandas aur Unit V ka Matplotlib isi par bane hain, aur aage course mein milne wale machine learning tools bhi. Sab kuch ek object se shuru hota hai: **array**.

learn: **NumPy import** karna aur list se **array** banana
**Vectorised** maths har item par ek saath kaise chalta hai, aur list alag kyun bartaav karti hai
Condition se array **filter** karna, jaise 125 se upar ki saari readings

explanation.heading: Array banana
explanation.md:
NumPy upar ek baar import hota hai, riwaaz ke mutaabik chhote naam **np** se. `np.array()` list ko **array** mein badalta hai:

```python
import numpy as np

doses = np.array([250, 500, 650])
print(doses)
print(doses.shape)
print(doses[0], doses[-1])
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
[250 500 650]
(3,)
250 650
```

Array bina commas ke print hota hai. `.shape` uska size deta hai: `(3,)` matlab ek row mein 3 items. Indexing aur slicing bilkul lists jaise chalte hain. List se alag, array mein **ek hi type** ki values hoti hain, aam taur par numbers.

callout.title: Array
callout.md: Ek type ki values ka NumPy grid, np.array() se banta hai. Array par maths har item par ek saath hota hai.

explanation.heading: Poore array par maths
explanation.md:
Yeh hai bada idea. Array par koi operation **har item** par lagta hai, bina loop ke. Ise **vectorised** maths kehte hain:

```python
import numpy as np

doses_mg = np.array([250, 500, 650])
print(doses_mg / 1000)
print(doses_mg * 2)

plain_list = [250, 500, 650]
print(plain_list * 2)
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
[0.25 0.5  0.65]
[ 500 1000 1300]
[250, 500, 650, 250, 500, 650]
```

Aakhri line dhyaan se dekhiye: **list** par `* 2` list ko dohraata hai, par **array** par har number ko dugna karta hai. Isi farq ki wajah se scientists data ke liye arrays use karte hain.

callout.title: list * 2, array * 2 nahi hai
callout.md: List dohraati hai; array hisaab lagaata hai. Readings par maths karne se pehle unhe np.array() se badaliye.

explanation.heading: Do arrays ek saath
explanation.md:
Ek hi length ke do arrays **item-dar-item** judte hain: pehla pehle se, doosra doosre se. Yahaan har bachche ka dose hai weight guna mg per kg:

```python
import numpy as np

weight = np.array([12, 20, 35])
mg_per_kg = np.array([15, 15, 10])
print(weight * mg_per_kg)
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
[180 300 350]
```

12 × 15 = 180, 20 × 15 = 300 aur 35 × 10 = 350, ek line mein. Lengths na milein to NumPy error deta hai.

explanation.heading: Ek shabd mein statistics
explanation.md:
Har lab report mein lagne wale saar ke liye arrays ke paas methods hain:

```python
import numpy as np

sugar = np.array([110, 126, 98, 140, 105])
print(sugar.mean())
print(sugar.max(), sugar.min())
print(round(sugar.std(), 2))
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
115.8
140 98
15.21
```

- `mean()` average hai, `max()` aur `min()` sabse bada aur sabse chhota, `sum()` kul jod.
- `std()` **standard deviation** hai: readings kitni phaili hui hain. Chhoti value matlab readings ek jaisi hain.
- `np.median(sugar)` readings sort karne par beech ki value deta hai.

explanation.heading: Condition se filter karna
explanation.md:
Array par comparison se `True` aur `False` ka array milta hai, har item ke liye ek. Use square brackets ke andar rakhne par sirf `True` wale items bachte hain:

```python
import numpy as np

sugar = np.array([110, 126, 98, 140, 105])
print(sugar > 125)
print(sugar[sugar > 125])
print((sugar > 125).sum())
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
[False  True False  True False]
[126 140]
2
```

Do readings 125 se upar thi. `True` ko 1 gina jaata hai, isliye `.sum()` unhe ginta hai. Conditions jodne ke liye `&` (and) ya `|` (or) use kijiye, **har condition ke chaaron or brackets** ke saath: `sugar[(sugar > 100) & (sugar < 130)]`.

callout.md: np.arange(0, 25, 6) deta hai [0 6 12 18 24], range() jaisa. np.linspace(0, 24, 5) 0 se 24 tak barabar doori ke 5 numbers deta hai: Unit V mein time points ke liye use karenge.

walkthrough.intro: Yeh program ek batch ki chhah tablets ka wazan check karta hai: average, range, aur 490 se 510 mg ke bahar koi tablet.

keyTerms.meaning: NumPy ko chhote naam np se load karo.
List ko NumPy array mein badlo.
Sirf condition se mel khaane wali values rakho.

steps.say: Yeh program ek batch ki chhah tablets ki quality jaldi check karta hai.
import numpy as n p, NumPy ko chhote naam n p se load karta hai.
Comment batata hai ki yeh tablets ke wazan milligrams mein hain.
n p dot array chhah wazanon ki list ko NumPy array w mein badalta hai.
w dot mean chhahon wazan jodkar chhah se divide karta hai. Average theek paanch sau hai.
min aur max sabse halki aur sabse bhaari tablet dete hain: chaar sau atthaasi aur paanch sau das.
Yeh mask chaar sau nabbe se kam, ya paanch sau das se zyada wali tablets rakhta hai. Har condition brackets mein hai, bar ke nishaan se judi, jiska matlab hai or.
Sirf ek tablet, chaar sau atthaasi milligrams, limit se bahar hai.

errors.intro: NumPy ke saath beginners ko sabse pehle yeh do errors milti hain.

examples.title: Import kiye bina np use karna
examples.md: Jab tak import na karein, Python `np` ko nahi jaanta. Program ke upar `import numpy as np` jodiye.

examples.title: Alag length ke arrays jodna
examples.md: Item-dar-item maths ke liye dono taraf barabar items chahiye: yahaan 3 weights hain par sirf 2 doses. Arrays ki length barabar kijiye.

mistakes.see: Koi error nahi, par `[250, 500, 250, 500]` milta hai

mistakes.mistake: Filter mein `and` / `or` use karna: `w[w > 490 and w < 510]`
mistakes.see: ValueError: The truth value of an array with more than one element is ambiguous. Use a.any() or a.all()
mistakes.fix: Brackets ke saath `&` aur `|` use kijiye: `w[(w > 490) & (w < 510)]`.

mistakes.see: Error ya galat nateeja, kyunki `&` pehle hal hota hai
mistakes.fix: Har condition ke chaaron or brackets lagaiye.

mistakes.see: Koi error nahi, par har item text ban jaata hai aur maths fail hota hai
mistakes.fix: Array mein sirf numbers rakhiye; text ko pehle int() ya float() se badaliye.

summary: **NumPy** `import numpy as np` se load hota hai; `np.array(list)` ek type ka **array** banata hai.
Array par maths **vectorised** hai: `doses / 1000` har item badalta hai, bina loop ke. List par `* 2` dohraata hai.
Barabar length ke do arrays **item-dar-item** judte hain: `weight * mg_per_kg`.
`mean()`, `max()`, `min()`, `sum()` aur `std()` ek shabd mein readings ka saar dete hain.
Condition se array filter hota hai: `sugar[sugar > 125]`; conditions `&` aur `|` se jodiye, har ek brackets mein.

print naya array dikhaata hai, grams mein.
Saadi list ke saath yahi karne ke liye for loop chahiye hota. Paanch sau patients ke saath array kahin tez hai.

glossary.meaning: Numerical Python: arrays par tez maths ki library. import numpy as np se load hoti hai.
Ek type ki values ka NumPy collection, np.array() se banta hai. Is par maths har item par chalta hai.
Array ke har item par ek saath, bina loop ke: doses / 1000.
Average: kul jod bhaag values ki sankhya. NumPy mein arr.mean().
Values mean ke aaspaas kitni phaili hain. arr.std(); chhota matlab readings ek jaisi hain.
Condition se bana True aur False ka array; arr[mask] sirf True wale items rakhta hai.
